label: What it does
value: Checks Darwin Core datasets (archives, IPT/GBIF/OBIS addresses or simple tables) against the EMODnet Biology / EurOBIS rules, which include the OBIS and GBIF rules, before they are harvested. Every issue points to a record.

label: Developed by
value: Tobias Büring, EMODnet Biology data management team, VLIZ (Flanders Marine Institute)

label: Disclaimer
value: This is a test (beta) version. The results are an aid for data providers and data managers, not a decision: the EMODnet Biology data management team decides what is harvested. Online checks use WoRMS, the NERC Vocabulary Server and OBIS; their content and availability are outside our control, and answers are stored for 30 days. No warranty of any kind.
